name: Takara B.D. Adventure
summary: Takara B.D. Adventure is one of the earliest Japanese full-scale text adventure games with pictures. The objective of the game is to find the secret tape and safely deliver it to Micro Cabin on the 5th floor of the Takara Building. There are also various hazards that will kill the player's character if not careful enough. There are no room descriptions and the text commands are in very simple English.
